drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis de $\widetilde{X}$ : deux anneaux hachurés le long de deux composantes du bord, l'épaisseur de chacun marquée $\varepsilon_{i}$, et sous le dessin « $0 \leqslant \varepsilon_{i} < +\infty$ »
drawings.kind: surface with collars (annuli along boundary components)
drawings.notes: Two rings (annuli along two boundary components), each with hatching on part of the collar and a small epsilon_i marking its width; under them "0 <= epsilon_i < +infinity". The long faint ruled-looking strokes crossing the crop belong to the writing of the page and are left out, as is a small struck sign above the right ring.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : une composante $(\partial'\widetilde{X})_{i}$ entourée d'une couronne hachurée, et dans celle-ci le cercle $\Gamma_{i}$
drawings.kind: boundary component with hatched collar
drawings.notes: Redrawn 2026-11-09 after Michel's check (#136) from a fresh crop of p. 3; the bbox is widened to take the hatching whole. Four closed hand-drawn curves, traced from the crop: the inner curve (the component); a curve round it, broken at the top where the label (d'X~)_i is written on it; a second closed curve that overlaps it, crossing it four times (its upper left side runs diagonally inside the first, its top and bottom run outside it, its right side inside it; this is the closed line the earlier redraw had split into two open pieces and a wrong closed curve); and the outer closed curve, with the short stroke where its pen line ends at the bottom right. The hatching of the collar, as the transcription says: thirteen pieces of long parallel oblique strokes, drawn grey, which run across the figure and out beyond it on both sides, stopping at the middle curves so that the region round the component is left blank (the topmost stroke and the long one through the top of the outer curve, and the lowest one, are whole). Labels \small: (d'X~)_i at the top, Gamma_i at the bottom left between the two middle curves. Left out: the small ticks where a hatching stroke meets a curve, the text around the figure. Still to settle (not asked in #136): which of the two middle curves is Gamma_i. Redrawn 2026-11-09: to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, trois croquis de cylindres traversés de cercles et de courbes, le troisième biffé
drawings.kind: cylinders crossed by circles and curves
drawings.notes: Two pencil cylinders, each between two horizontal lines and crossed by three closed curves. Omitted as struck: the third cylinder (bottom left), struck through by oblique strokes. The marginal words on the right ("cylindre ...") are left out. Issue 128, 2026-11-09: struck material left out after a fresh check of the facsimile (struck-out material is not drawn). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: feuillet de croquis, formules éparses et dessins dans tous les sens ; on n'en donne que les formules
drawings.kind: page of sketches (surfaces, pants, spheres)
drawings.notes: Whole page, drawn upright as rendered (the formulas, written upside down, are left out: they are in the transcription). Top: a Y-shaped piece (pair of pants, heavy stem, doubled arms) with a heavy bar under it; a small circle on a doubled stalk; a thin crescent; a large circle drawn twice over, with a short tail. Middle: faint pencil hills (the left one, a larger one) on a base line, with three short strokes at their right (pencil). Long thin lines: one from the small circle down to the lower right (with a bend where it crosses the step line), one parallel to it from the middle left down to the bottom, a third further left, and a faint line rising to the right under the formula. Lower half: the long ink line with its step, the shorter line under it; the blob with three crescents and a small loop, and its lower loop; the heavy vertical stroke under it; a sphere with two meridian arcs at the right. Left out: all formulas and words, the faint pencil writing at the lower left, the strokes underlining the formulas at the bottom right. Still differs: the faint pencil hills and the blob with its crescents are approximate. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: sur une enveloppe, un croquis sans légende : un grand disque contenant un disque plus petit autour d'un point marqué, et deux petits disques cerclés autour de deux autres points ; à côté, un second contour fermé avec un point
drawings.kind: discs with marked points
drawings.notes: On the envelope: a closed contour with one point (top), and a large disc containing a smaller disc around a marked point, and two small ringed points (bottom). The printed address and the handwritten name on the envelope are outside the crop and left out.

drawings.description: en bas à droite, un croquis : une sphère, $z$ au pôle nord, $z'$ au pôle sud, quelques méridiens et un point marqué $x$
drawings.kind: sphere with poles and meridians
drawings.notes: The sphere as he drew it (an irregular closed outline through both poles), z at the north pole (heavy point) and z' at the south pole (small ring); a meridian from z curving down the middle to z'; a heavy line from z down to the lower left; a curve from the upper right down towards the centre; the equator-like curve from the left edge to the right edge; a short stroke from the right end of that curve downwards; three oblique strokes over the left part (his hatching); a short stroke right of z'. Still differs: no point labelled x is found on the facsimile; it is not drawn (the earlier redraw placed one by guess); the small dashes inside the sphere are left out. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en marge du dernier alinéa, un croquis : un demi-disque dont le diamètre porte un point marqué.
drawings.kind: half-disc with a marked point
drawings.notes: A half-disc; the diameter carries a marked point, and its right end is overinked.

drawings.description: au crayon, sur la moitié droite du feuillet (tenu dans le sens de son écriture), trois croquis : en haut une sphère portant les points marqués $1$, $0$, $\infty$ et $\alpha$ (ce dernier cerclé), coupée par un grand cercle presque vertical, dont la moitié arrière est en tirets, et par un équateur ; à gauche, plus bas, un ovale étroit dont un bord est en tirets, dans un contour plus large à peine tracé, marqué $\alpha_0$ ; en bas une sphère dont l'équateur porte $0$, $1$ et, à l'arrière, $\infty$, chacun relié au pôle par un arc.
drawings.kind: three pencil sketches: two spheres with marked points, an oval
drawings.notes: The sheet is upside down in the scan (his writing runs the other way from the printed listing); the crop is turned by 180 degrees and the sketches are redrawn upright. Top: the sphere (outline as one closed curve; he went over it twice), the equator drawn as its front arc, the nearly vertical great circle (left half full, right half dashed), the points 1 (upper left), 0 (upper right), infinity (on the equator, right of the great circle) and alpha (ringed, at the left end of the equator), a thin line from the point 1 to the great circle carrying two small points, the stroke from alpha to the point 1, an arc on the right from the top through 0 down to the bottom, and two small crosses. Left: the narrow oval (right edge dashed), the wider faint contour round it, and the label alpha_0. Bottom: the sphere, its equator (an ellipse), the pole with a tick above it, the points 0, 1 on the front of the equator and infinity at the back, and the three arcs from the pole. Left out: a fourth, very faint, unlabelled oval at the upper left of the crop; his formulas and the printed listing. Still differs: in the top sphere several faint pencil arcs inside the outline (between alpha, the great circle and the bottom) are not all drawn, and those that are drawn are a reading; outlines are smooth curves through read points. The transcription's note says « le pôle $\infty$ » for the third sphere: on the page infinity sits on the back of the equator and the pole is unlabelled. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.orientation: sheet upside down in the scan: crop rotated by 180 degrees, drawn upright

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, à hauteur du passage encadré : un arc descendant qui fait un coin en un point marqué (le point $x$), un ovale en tirets autour de ce point, avec une croix à l'intérieur, et à droite du coin une région hachurée entre une corde et un arc.
drawings.kind: arc with a corner at a marked point, dashed neighbourhood, hatched region
drawings.notes: As on the page: the arc comes down from the upper right, turns back to a heavy point at the tip of a wedge (the point x of the lemma), and goes on downwards; round the point a dashed oval, with a small cross inside it at the lower left; right of the wedge a region bounded by a straight stroke and an arc, hatched obliquely. Arc, wedge and the straight stroke are drawn through the same computed points. Still differs: the hatching is five strokes on the page, set by the pattern here; the dashed oval is an ellipse fitted to his broken outline. The transcription's note says « un point $x$ sur un arc, un voisinage en pointillé, une rive hachurée »: agreed, save that the letter x is not written by the sketch (a cross stands inside the oval). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, au bas de la page : un arc ondulé qui descend et s'arrête en un point marqué, au milieu d'un disque au contour interrompu ; une croix sous le point.
drawings.kind: arc ending at a marked point inside a disc
drawings.notes: As on the page: a wavy arc coming down from above and ending at a heavy point inside a disc; the outline of the disc is drawn by him in five or six separate strokes and is set here as a dashed ellipse fitted to them; a small cross just under the end point (his mark for x). Nothing left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, en regard du premier « Lemme 3 » barré, deux croquis. En haut, deux segments presque horizontaux l'un sous l'autre, chacun portant un point marqué vers son milieu et terminé à droite par un point noté « $1$ », hachurés l'un au-dessus, l'autre au-dessous (deux demi-plans), et une flèche verticale du premier au second. En bas, un demi-disque dont le diamètre porte un point marqué, d'où part un arc ondulé qui rejoint le demi-cercle.
drawings.kind: two sketches: two hatched half-planes glued along their edges; half-disc cut by an arc
drawings.notes: Top: the two edges, each drawn between its end points with the marked point computed on it; hatching above the upper edge and below the lower one (five oblique strokes each, as on the page); the end points and the two labels 1; the vertical arrow from the upper to the lower edge. Bottom: the diameter, the half-circle through its two ends, the heavy point on the diameter and the wavy arc from it to a computed point of the half-circle; a small hook under the point. Left out: the three long oblique strokes that strike the first « Lemme 3 » and cross the upper sketch; the words of the text at the right. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

figures.what: two hatched half-planes and an arrow

drawings.description: en haut à gauche, sous les mots écrits en biais : une courbe fermée, un point $b$ sur elle, en haut à droite ; de $b$ part vers l'intérieur un arc épais qui s'arrête en un point $a$, et vers l'extérieur deux branches marquées $\zeta$ et $\bar\zeta$ ; à l'intérieur, en bas, une petite flèche courbe d'orientation.
drawings.kind: closed curve with a boundary point b, an inner arc to a and two outer branches
drawings.notes: As on the page: the closed curve C as one closed curve through points read on his outline; the point b on it; the arc I from b inwards to its end point a (heavy in its lower half), labelled a; the two short branches leaving b outwards, the left one labelled zeta and the right one zeta-bar; the small curved arrow inside, near the bottom. All four strokes at b start from the same point. Left out: the marginal « NB … » written obliquely across the upper left of the curve, the two blots he made at b, and the title « Lemme 4 ». Still differs: the upper left of the outline is hidden under the oblique writing and is interpolated; the letters C and I are not written on the figure (the transcription's note names the curve and the arc after the text). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, à hauteur de B) : un cercle dont le bord porte trois petits traits marqués $\zeta$ (en haut à gauche), $1$ (à droite) et $\bar\zeta$ (en bas à gauche), et les trois arcs qu'ils découpent, notés $\alpha$ (à gauche), $\beta$ (en haut à droite) et $\bar\beta$ (en bas).
drawings.kind: circle with three marked points and the three arcs named
drawings.notes: As on the page: the circle (an ellipse fitted to his outline, which is taller than wide), three short ticks across it at the points zeta (upper left), 1 (right) and zeta-bar (lower left), each placed on the circle at the direction where he drew it, and the names of the three arcs written inside the circle next to each arc: alpha at the left, beta at the upper right, beta-bar at the bottom. The outline is doubled at the bottom on the page (the stroke overshoots where it closes); that is not reproduced. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut à gauche : un cercle, son centre marqué d'un petit rond noté $0$, et un arc ondulé qui va du centre au point du bord noté $1$, à droite.
drawings.kind: disc with a wavy arc from the centre to the boundary point 1
drawings.notes: As on the page: the circle, a small full point at its centre with the label 0 just under it (his small round), the wavy arc from that point to the point of the circle at the right, computed on the circle, with a short tick and the label 1 outside. Nothing left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: feuillet de dessins, sans un mot ni une formule : neuf sphères tracées à main levée au feutre (noir, brun, vert, orange, bleu), chacune découpée par un réseau d'arcs de grands cercles en régions dont certaines sont hachurées ou coloriées ; la plus grande, en orange, en haut à droite, est coupée par quatre cordes en secteurs, l'un hachuré
drawings.kind: page of spheres cut by great circles (coloured felt pens)
drawings.notes: Drawn on a computer printout; the printout text is left out. Nine spheres at their places on the sheet, each outline an ellipse and every chord ending exactly on its outline (endpoints projected onto it), crossings computed: 1 (left) shaded all over, with its network of wavy arcs; 2 (top centre) two chords crossing, the cap above their crossing hatched, a dashed arc behind; a small closed contour beside it; 3 (centre) two chords crossing, the top cap hatched, a dashed arc; 4 (top right, the largest) four chords, the sector between three of them hatched, with a line running down from it to sphere 9; 5 (bottom left, small) two chords and an arc; 6 a network of chords and arcs meeting at a point near the bottom; 7 two crossing chords and two arcs; 8 (thin outline) a vertical chord, two crossing chords, a hatched triangle with a marked point, a heavy arc on the right; 9 (thin outline) eight curved spokes from one point, a small hatched triangle at it, a marked point, a heavy arc on the right. Still differs: the felt-pen colours are not visible on the grey facsimile available here and are not rendered (the description names black, brown, green, orange, blue); the networks inside spheres 1 and 6 are approximate; arcs of great circles are drawn as chords or as smooth curves. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, à hauteur de « fondamentaux » : un petit carré, sans lettres.
drawings.kind: small square, unlabelled
drawings.notes: A small square drawn free-hand in four strokes, with no letter; redrawn as a closed quadrilateral through its four corners as read (on the page the strokes do not quite join at three of the corners). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, sous la note « $j = \tfrac12\log a$ ? » : un hexagone, sans lettres, avec son axe vertical, qui dépasse en haut et en bas, et la diagonale horizontale qui joint ses deux sommets latéraux.
drawings.kind: hexagon with its vertical axis and a horizontal diagonal
drawings.notes: As on the page: the hexagon (two horizontal sides, two lateral vertices), every side drawn between the same six vertices; the horizontal diagonal through the two lateral vertices, slightly overshooting them; the vertical axis through the middles of the two horizontal sides, overshooting above and below. On the page the oblique sides are gone over several times and the bottom side runs a little past its right end; neither is reproduced. No letters on the figure. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, à hauteur du cas $n = 4$ : un carré posé sur ses deux axes, tracés en tirets et qui le dépassent, avec deux flèches issues du centre vers les deux sommets du haut, notés $e_{1}$ (à gauche) et $e_{0}$ (à droite) ; au-dessus, deux traits obliques, l'un plein, l'autre en tirets, qui montent des sommets du haut vers le haut de l'axe vertical.
drawings.kind: square on its axes with the vectors e_0, e_1 from the centre
drawings.notes: As on the page: the square, its four sides between the same four corners; the two axes through the centre, dashed, overshooting the square (the vertical one further down, where a small cross stands on it); two arrows from the centre to the upper left and upper right corners, labelled e_1 and e_0; above the square, a full stroke from the upper left corner to the top of the vertical axis and a dashed stroke from that top towards the upper right corner (the upper half of the square on the diagonals). Still differs: whether the two oblique strokes above are meant as two sides of a second square is not decided; the dashes of the axes are schematic. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, à hauteur du cas hexagonal : un hexagone de sommets notés $v - u$, $v$, $u$, $u - v$, $-v$, $-u$, avec six flèches du centre vers les sommets, et au-dessus du côté du haut un triangle dont le sommet est noté $2v - u$.
drawings.kind: hexagon with named vertices, arrows from the centre, outer triangle with apex 2v-u
drawings.notes: As on the page: the six sides of the hexagon between the same six vertices, the six arrows from the centre to the vertices, the two sides of the outer triangle from the vertices v-u and v to the apex, and the seven labels where he wrote them (2v-u above the apex; v-u and v at the top; -u and u at the left and right; -v and u-v at the bottom). On the page the two sides of the outer triangle stop just short of the top side and of each other, and some sides are drawn in two strokes; the redraw joins them at the vertices. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, sous le mot « Démonstration » : l'hexagone, sommets notés $v - u$ et $v$ en haut, $-u$ à gauche, « $e_{0} = u_{+}$ » à droite (au bout d'une flèche épaisse issue du centre, sous laquelle est écrit $e_{0}$), $-v$ et « $\sigma v = u - v$ » en bas ; au-dessus, le sommet du triangle extérieur, noté « $2v - u = u_{-}$ » après un mot biffé ; des traits et des flèches vont du centre aux sommets, un axe vertical en tirets descend du sommet du triangle au centre.
drawings.kind: hexagon with named vertices, arrows from the centre, outer apex u_-
drawings.notes: As on the page, with every stroke between the same computed vertices: the outer triangle on the top side (its two sides from v-u and v to the apex, labelled « 2v-u = u_- »); the top side, dashed; the sides v-u to -u, v to e_0 = u_+, e_0 to u-v, -u to -v and the bottom side; the heavy arrow from the centre to e_0 = u_+, with e_0 written under it; arrows from the centre to -v and to u-v; plain strokes from the centre to v-u, to v and to -u; the dashed vertical axis from the apex to the centre. Labels where he wrote them. Left out: the struck word before « 2v-u », a struck sign inside the triangle, a short dashed vertical under v, and the word « Démonstration » above. Still differs: which of the strokes from the centre carry an arrowhead is a reading (heads are clear on e_0, -v and u-v; the stroke from -u towards v-u also seems to carry a head, not drawn); the label at the upper right vertex is overwritten and is given after the transcription as v. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
